literature_notes: HCN2 is a six-transmembrane hyperpolarization-activated channel with both termini intracellular. The two ledger lines available are: L1 (C-terminal FLAG at residue 889, topology INTRACELLULAR 461–889) and L2 (N-terminal FLAG at residue 1, topology INTRACELLULAR 1–211). Both tags face the cytoplasm and are therefore not surface tag sites. The three extracellular loops — EC1 (234–244, 11 aa), EC2 (309–324, 16 aa), and EC3 (378–440, 63 aa, the S5-pore-S6 region) — are not addressed by any ledger line. No ledger evidence supports an extracellular insertion anywhere in this protein, so sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal FLAG tag on full-length HCN2 used in surface biotinylation assays; residue 889 lies within the intracellular C-terminal domain (topology 461–889), not on the extracellular face.
N-terminal FLAG tag on murine HCN2 in an AAV cardiac expression construct; residue 1 lies within the intracellular N-terminal domain (topology 1–211), not on the extracellular face.
